derivation:
by
  ext x; apply congrFun; apply (denseRange G).equalizer f.hom.continuous_toFun g.hom.continuous_toFun
  funext y; simpa [GrpCat.comp_apply] using! (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h y)
explanation: DenseRange.equalizer states that continuous maps into a Hausdorff space agreeing after composition with a dense-range function are equal. Instantiate that function with etaFn G, using the established denseRange G; the remaining steps only translate categorical morphisms into functions.
